options.content:
**How many AI calls TSG made in the time chosen at the top right, and for what.** Counts only. *Module* and *API call* at the top narrow every panel but the by-model table and the tracking checks at the bottom (All = everything); hover the (i) by a title for what it counts.

- **AI call**: one try sent to an AI model; a retried call counts each try.
- **Earlier answer reused**: a job's retry read back an answer it had: no call.
- **Part**: the step the call was for.

Exact numbers for one session or request: **One session or request**, at the bottom.

panels.title: In the chosen time
panels.description: The whole picture in eight numbers, for the modules and API calls chosen at the top.

panels.title: API calls that started AI work
panels.description: API calls that start AI work (Create scenario, Next set, Regenerate scenarios, Create remediation plan, Regenerate plan, Map services, Regenerate mapping) that answered 202: work started. A 200 (a repeat, or nothing new to do) or an error started none. Prometheus counts over the chosen time, from every pod's counters (a pod's first calls and a restarted pod's count too); the exact numbers, per request and per session, come from GET /v1/ai-usage (no key).

targets.expr:
sum(label_replace(
  label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(
    (((tsg_http_requests_total{method="POST", status="202"} - tsg_http_requests_total{method="POST", status="202"} offset $__range) and resets(tsg_http_requests_total{method="POST", status="202"}[$__range]) == 0) or (round(increase(tsg_http_requests_total{method="POST", status="202"}[$__range])) and last_over_time(tsg_http_requests_total{method="POST", status="202"}[1h] offset $__range)) or (max_over_time(tsg_http_requests_total{method="POST", status="202"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(tsg_http_requests_total{method="POST", status="202"}[1h] offset $__range))),
  "call", "threat_scenarios/create_scenario", "route", "/v1/sessions"),
  "call", "threat_scenarios/next_set", "route", "/v1/sessions/[^/]+/scenarios/next-set"),
  "call", "threat_scenarios/regenerate", "route", "/v1/sessions/[^/]+/regenerate/scenarios"),
  "call", "remediation/create_plan", "route", "/v1/remediation"),
  "call", "remediation/regenerate", "route", "/v1/sessions/[^/]+/scenarios/[^/]+/treatment-plan/regenerate"),
  "call", "service_mapper/create_mapping", "route", "/v1/service-mapper"),
  "call", "service_mapper/regenerate", "route", "/v1/service-mapper/[^/]+/regenerate"),
"picked", "1", "call", "($module)/($api)")
and on (picked) label_replace(vector(1), "picked", "1", "", "")) or vector(0)

panels.title: AI calls
panels.description: Tries sent to an AI model (writing, embedding, ranking), retries included. Prometheus counts over the chosen time, from every pod's counters (a pod's first calls and a restarted pod's count too); the exact numbers, per request and per session, come from GET /v1/ai-usage (no key).

targets.expr: sum((((tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", outcome!="reused"} - tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", outcome!="reused"} offset $__range) and resets(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", outcome!="reused"}[$__range]) == 0) or (round(increase(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", outcome!="reused"}[$__range])) and last_over_time(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", outcome!="reused"}[1h] offset $__range)) or (max_over_time(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", outcome!="reused"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", outcome!="reused"}[1h] offset $__range)))) or vector(0)

(sum((((tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", api!="none", outcome!="reused"} - tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", api!="none", outcome!="reused"} offset $__range) and resets(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", api!="none", outcome!="reused"}[$__range]) == 0) or (round(increase(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", api!="none", outcome!="reused"}[$__range])) and last_over_time(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", api!="none", outcome!="reused"}[1h] offset $__range)) or (max_over_time(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", api!="none", outcome!="reused"}[$__range]) unless last_over_time(tsg_ai_usage_calls_total{module=~"$module", api=~"$api", api!="none", outcome!="reused"}[1h] offset $__range)))) or vector(0)) / (sum(label_replace(

panels.title: AI calls per API call, by part of the work
panels.description: One line per API call: how often it started work and the AI calls its work made in each part.

panels.title: AI calls per API call and part
panels.description: One line per API call that starts AI work: how often it started work, then the AI calls its jobs made in each part, in total and failed. Create scenario: Starts a run: finds threats, writes the first set, picks controls. Next set: Writes the next set of scenarios for the run. Regenerate scenarios: Rewrites the chosen scenarios. Create remediation plan: Writes a treatment plan for one scenario. Regenerate plan: Writes a new version of the plan. Map services: Finds upstream and downstream services for a service. Regenerate mapping: Runs the mapping again to add new services. 'No API call' lines: shared work, and jobs started without one. Prometheus counts over the chosen time, from every pod's counters (a pod's first calls and a restarted pod's count too); the exact numbers, per request and per session, come from GET /v1/ai-usage (no key).

threats/relevance_gate.text: AI picks which library threats apply to the asset (one call per batch of up to 10 threats)

threats/gap_fill.text: AI suggests a threat for a category where no library threat applies

threats/embed.text: Turns the asset text into vectors to search the library

threats/rerank.text: Ranks library threats against a suggested one

scenario/threat_actions.text: AI listed the attacker actions a threat's name describes (older runs only)

scenario/write_scenario.text: AI writes a set of attack scenarios, one per attack path, in one call

scenario/repair_scenario.text: AI rewrites, in one call, the scenarios of a set that were unusable or missed planned actions

scenario/plan_check.text: AI checks, in one call, that each scenario of a set carries out its plan

scenario/embed.text: Searches threat intelligence for a scenario's evidence

scenario/rerank.text: Ranks the evidence found for a scenario

controls/embed.text: Turns the scenario into a vector to search the controls

controls/rerank.text: Ranks candidate controls by how well they fit

remediation/remediation_plan.text: AI writes the treatment plan for the scenario's controls

service_mapper/service_mapper.text: AI lists upstream and downstream services for a service

service_mapper/embed.text: Searches the service catalog for candidates

shared/embed.text: Embeds new or changed library and evidence rows

shared/rerank.text: A ranking no single request asked for

panels.description: Usage rows MongoDB did not take: each was logged whole (ai.usage_row_spilled) and can be replayed within 7 days (deploy/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md, 'AI usage rows not stored'). AiUsageNotRecorded fires when any is in 15 minutes. The AI calls went on.

panels.title: Since the hourly add-up last finished
panels.description: How long since the 5-minute hourly add-up on the maintenance worker last finished: red after 15 minutes (AiUsageRollupBehind fires 5 minutes later). 'Not reported yet': no add-up since that worker started (the alert fires after 25 minutes). Per-request reports never wait for it.

targets.expr: (time() - max(tsg_ai_usage_rollup_last_success_timestamp_seconds)) or vector(-1)
targets.legendFormat: Since the hourly add-up last finished

panels.title: Time to store one ask's usage rows (95 in 100 within)
panels.description: 95 in 100 asks stored their usage rows within this time. Past 5 seconds a write gives up and its rows are logged for replay instead.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(tsg_ai_usage_write_seconds_bucket[$__range])))
targets.legendFormat: Time to store one ask's usage rows (95 in 100 within)

options.content: Paste a **session id** (a run's) or a **request id** (from an error message or a log line) in **Session or request id** at the top, then click. Reports open in a new tab: JSON from the TSG API, no key needed, the exact numbers from the stored usage rows. | You have | Open | |---|---| | A session id | Its API calls: each with its AI calls per part and model, and the session's totals | | | Its every AI call: when, activity, model, outcome, tokens, seconds | | A request id | Its AI calls by activity: name, one-line description, model | | | Its every AI call | | Either | [Its log lines on the home page](/grafana/d/tsg/tsg?var-id=${session:percentencode}&${__url_time_range}&viewPanel=panel-60) | No id: AI calls by module and API call in the chosen time, from the hourly totals (up to 5 minutes behind).
